title: vibeic.ppa.claims.v1 — every public claim bound to the evidence that supports it
description: A claims document is the join between a sentence a reader will believe and the artefact that makes it true. A claim without an `evidence` entry is an assertion; a claim whose `status` outruns the status of its evidence is a claim about silicon that no artefact supports. Both are refused by ppa_page_claim_check.py. The `NOT_MEASURED` status is a first-class member of this document and is never omitted: a claims file that silently drops what could not be measured reads as complete coverage.

schema.description: First key of every instance document (PPA_INTERFACES.md §5).

generated_by.description: The program that produced this document, e.g. `ppa_report_gen.py`.

report.description: Path of the report.md these claims were emitted alongside, relative to the run root.

coverage.description: The stated denominator. Present so that a reader can tell `nothing was measured` from `nothing was looked at` without recounting the rows.

claims.description: May be empty ONLY when `coverage.total` is 0 and the report states that zero explicitly. An empty array is a stated zero, never a silent one.

id.description: Cited from prose as `[claim:<id>]`. Unique within the document.

text.description: The public sentence, exactly as a reader will meet it.

status.description: Same vocabulary as vibeic.ppa.metric.v1 (PPA_INTERFACES.md §2). A claim may never carry a status STRONGER than the weakest evidence record it cites; MEASURED is the strongest.

metric.description: The canonical metric name this claim is about, when it is about one.

value.description: Present ONLY when status is MEASURED or DERIVED. There are no numeric sentinels: 0, -1 and "" never mean `not measured`.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status is NOT_MEASURED, NOT_APPLICABLE or INVALID. It carries a reason, not a value.

formula.description: REQUIRED when status is DERIVED — a reader must be able to recompute the number themselves.

scope.description: Two numbers are comparable only if their scope matches (PPA_INTERFACES.md §2). `base` and `reviewed` are the two qualification fields ppa_page_claim_check.py reads.

base.description: The revision/version the statement was measured AT. A statement about the tree that carries no base pin reads present-tense and goes false without anyone editing it — measured 2026-08-21, three published sentences went false in one day at v1.11.12.

reviewed.description: What was actually reviewed, when. This is what lifts a `nobody` / `no open flow` form from an unbounded universal to a bounded search.

criterion.description: The falsifiable test the sentence would fail. `converges`, `honest` and `nothing violates` are not criteria until one is written here.

definitions.description: Terms the sentence leans on that a reader would otherwise supply themselves.

evidence.description: Empty is legal ONLY for status NOT_MEASURED — where the absence of evidence IS the fact being reported.

sha256.description: `sha256:<hex>` from _ppa/canonical_json.digest_of, over the value that was PARSED — never one that was recomputed.

status.description: The status of the underlying metric record. A MEASURED claim citing a NOT_MEASURED record is the defect this whole document exists to make visible.
